instruction: I want GIMP to automatically save my work every 5 minutes. Can you set up auto-save?

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because GIMP does not have a built-in auto-save feature that can be configured through its preferences or settings. While GIMP has auto-recovery for crashes, there is no user-configurable automatic save interval.
